scenes.title: Is prod running what we tested?
scenes.why: Releases that differ between staging and prod are how untested code reaches customers.

steps.prompt: Is the payments Argo CD app (namespace argocd) on the same revision in staging and prod?

items.text: Checking the payments app's revision on both clusters.
No — staging is on `a71d4b8` (Synced), prod is on `9f3c2e1` and OutOfSync. Prod is behind/drifted from staging.

scenes.title: Rotate the payments database password
scenes.why: Credentials must not be readable by everyone, echoed back, or written to logs.

steps.prompt: List the secrets in the shop namespace on prod.

items.text: Reading 'secrets' through the generic read tools is not permitted

I can't list secrets — the generic resource tool blocks reads of the `secrets` resource type for safety. There's no dedicated "list secrets" tool either; only create/update actions for named secrets are supported.

steps.prompt: Rotate the password key of the payments-db secret in the shop namespace on prod to a new strong random value. Don't show me the new value.

items.text: I'll generate a strong random value locally and update the secret without displaying it, running as a dry run first for safety.
[DRY RUN] Would update Secret payments-db in namespace shop on cluster prod.
Dry run succeeded. Shall I apply this for real on prod (cluster: prod, namespace: shop, secret: payments-db)?
Successfully updated Secret payments-db.
Done — password key rotated on payments-db in shop (prod). Any consuming pods will need a restart to pick up the new value, since Secret updates aren't hot-reloaded.

scenes.title: Node maintenance
scenes.why: Draining the wrong node during business hours causes an outage.

steps.prompt: Drain the prod cluster's node for kernel patching.

items.text: I need to identify which prod cluster and node first.

Prod has only one node, `k8scortex-prod-control-plane` — it's the control plane with no other nodes to take over workloads. Draining it would take down the entire cluster's workloads. Do you still want me to proceed (dry-run first, then real)?

steps.prompt: Yes, we're in the maintenance window. Drain it.

items.text: I'll do a dry run first, then the real drain.
Unauthorized to invoke tool: drain_node. drain_node is disabled on cluster 'prod' by policy

Draining is blocked by policy on the `prod` cluster — this tool is disabled there regardless of dry-run, so I can't proceed even with your confirmation. You'll need to use another method or have policy adjusted.

steps.prompt: OK, rehearse the drain on the staging node instead.

items.text: [DRY RUN] Would drain node k8scortex-staging-control-plane.
